scope: Same-assistant exact-span review on the seven unedited outputs. The original five public and five private criteria, origin-or-nationality rule, role-capacity rule, and treatment of uncertain guards are reused. Materially false national rationales are flagged against the complete locked historical source. Only delivered evidence can supply private credit.
